inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A continuous ten-second cinematic LIVE-ACTION fight. Scorpion relentlessly BEATS SUB-ZERO BACK with fast hard combinations and leaves him STANDING DAZED. EXACTLY the same two adult human stunt actors as Picture1, with identical human faces/proportions, masks, black hoods, wet practical cloth costumes and boots. Yellow-and-black Scorpion LEFT, blue-and-black Sub-Zero RIGHT, same sunlit ruined stone courtyard and existing water/frost on the stones. Serious aggressive martial-arts performance, normal real-time speed. Scorpion is determined to overwhelm his opponent; Sub-Zero tries to survive, defend and regain his footing.

Continue immediately from Picture1: Scorpion's raised boot plants and he drives forward off that landing. He snaps a LEFT jab into the blue guard, instantly follows with a RIGHT straight into the upper chest, and whips a compact LEFT hook into the exposed ribs. Each fist HITS AND SPRINGS BACK at once while the next punch accelerates. The chest hit drives blue shoulders backward; the rib hit folds his torso and turns his pelvis. Sub-Zero's rear boot takes a fast catching step as he tries to restore his guard. Scorpion gives him no pause: he snaps a RIGHT FRONT KICK into the blue abdomen, folds the knee back IMMEDIATELY and plants the boot while the blue body is still recoiling into another catching step.

Scorpion pursues those forced steps. He lashes a short LEFT LOW KICK into the outside of the blue forward thigh, springs the shin away and plants. Sub-Zero's knee yields AFTER contact; he stumbles into a wider base and throws a desperate short icy counterpunch. Scorpion slips his head outside that punch and drives a hard RIGHT body hook into the ribs, instantly retracts it, then snaps a LEFT cross into the blue jaw/cheek line. The blue shoulders and head turn from the actual contact, after the yellow fist has already pulled back. Scorpion stays balanced and close, reading the stagger instead of presenting a pose.

Before Sub-Zero can regain his footing, Scorpion bends his knees, pushes through his rear boot, rotates his hips and drives ONE compact RIGHT UPPERCUT under the blue chin. Show the real fist reaching the chin BEFORE the head and shoulders snap upward/back. The yellow fist immediately retracts. The blue heels briefly lift from that external hit, then his boots LAND with bent knees and he takes two uneven catching steps backward. No floating or voluntary falling.

The accumulated impacts now leave Sub-Zero visibly GROGGY: shoulders drop, hands sag below his chest, knees stay soft and his head struggles to steady. He tries to raise his guard and refocus on Scorpion, but the attempt falters and he has to catch his balance again. This dazed response happens AFTER the blows. No smile, cartoon stars, goofy swaying or dancing. He remains upright, stunned and vulnerable, still the same blue-masked man. Scorpion advances one grounded step with his fists ready, intent on the dazed opponent. End with that uneven blue recovery still moving; do not add the fire finisher or remove either mask yet.

Explosive short combinations: contact occupies an instant, the receiver keeps recoiling AFTER the attacking limb has separated, and the next attack starts during recovery. Hits visibly move ribs, shoulders, hips and center of mass; catching steps pay for that force. Do not park fists on a guard or hold a kicking leg against a torso. Orange FIRE briefly follows Scorpion's own moving fist/shin and disperses on retraction. Blue-white ICE remains on Sub-Zero's own forearms; small chips/vapor follow impacts. Effects stay small enough to show real contact and never freeze the action.

CAMERA starts at Picture1's exact viewpoint and tracks backward/sideways with the blue forced retreat, making a modest same-axis diagonal arc as Scorpion pursues. Keep yellow LEFT and blue RIGHT, both complete bodies, boots and every major contact visible. Courtyard columns move against the doorway in parallax. Maintain sunlight and photographic cloth/skin. A single uninterrupted shot, no slow motion, artificial shake, cuts, new people or text. This is an UNARMED beatdown; waist accessories remain fastened throughout.

overall_soundscape: Fast compact punch impacts, deeper body-hit thuds, two distinct kick impacts, one sharp final uppercut, urgent chasing/catching footfalls, cloth snaps and quiet courtyard wind. Brief fire swishes on yellow attacks and brittle ice ticks on blue forearms. No speech, grunts, laughter or music.

non_diegetic_music: None.

_meta.title: T05 R2 — unarmed Scorpion pressure, impact and visible post-hit daze
